decision.summary: The copied Workshop authority court remains migration evidence only. The accepted canonical replacement composes one Workshop Workbench in the Universal Cell graph. It makes shared Work, research gates, prioritisation, founder approval, and bounded provider-review evidence available through one authorised scope rather than independent model task stores.
accepted_canonical_behavior: Workshop is a graph composition rooted in the application and reached through the authorised Brain Workbench lens
Workbench scope contains the canonical Workshop root, governed Work registry, assignment registry, and claim-binding authority without raw duplicate Brain cards
research evidence is required before a claimed Workshop item can advance to coordination
admitted GPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, and local reviewers receive bounded shared coordination context only after the normal claim, plan, approval, and one-use grant path
provider output is bounded untrusted review evidence and cannot complete or mutate Work by itself
founder model-council reports redact protected Work and provider requests remain read-only until explicit execution
rejected_or_not_promoted: separate per-model task queues, copied Workshop status, or provider-created priority authority
bulk copying runtime source into canonical authority
